name: llm-markdown-sitemap-extractor
title: Fast LLM-Ready Markdown & Sitemap Crawler (RAG / MCP)
description: Ultra-fast, zero-browser HTML-to-Markdown crawler for RAG pipelines, Claude, Cursor, n8n & MCP agents. Supports direct URLs or automatic sitemap.xml discovery, removes boilerplate/nav/scripts, preserves code blocks & headings, and estimates token counts.
